subject: Post-call: Dedicated capacity recap & next steps (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Post-call: Dedicated capacity recap & next steps (Acme Health)

Taylor — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth. Happy to adjust if I missed anything.

Summary of pain points / goals we heard
- Latency and tail latency on peak inference traffic (customer-facing chat) — p50/p95 currently ~300/1,200ms and spikes causing poor UX.
- Cost predictability and isolation: need a reserved dedicated pool (no multitenant co-tenancy) for PHI-processing flows.
- Autoscaling during weekly traffic bursts (up to 6x baseline) with predictable cold-start behavior.
- Compliance: requirement for VPC-only access, customer-managed KMS keys, and SOC2 evidence.

Proposed Redwood Dedicated configuration (initial recommendation)
- Reserved capacity: 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs (committed) in a single dedicated GPU pool for production.
- Burst/Scale plan: enable autoscale to burst up to 16 GPUs for scheduled high-traffic windows. Warm pool + continuous batching to reduce cold starts.
- Isolation: Dedicated tenancy + VPC peering (or Private deployment option) + KMS integration for key control.
- SLA targets: 99.95% uptime SLA; latency SLO target: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms for typical chat flows (subject to model/seq-length).

Attachments: I attached a short Requirements doc outlining the config above and the items we promised to follow up on (Dedicated_Requirements_Acme_Health_v1.pdf).

Open questions / clarifications for Acme
- Confirmation on data residency (single US region ok?) and whether you need on-prem/on-prem-like air-gapped options for any workloads.
- Expected baseline QPS and peak QPS during bursts (if you have sample traces we can run a sizing sim).
- Legal / procurement timelines: do you prefer an initial order form + SOW or a one-off POC order?

Next steps
1) I will send a proposed pricing range + order form (Ben) — by EOD tomorrow.
2) Schedule technical deep-dive with Solutions Eng (Marissa) to validate sizing and network requirements — proposed times below.
3) You to share any traffic traces and security questionnaire (Taylor).

Proposed times for deep-dive: Fri 20 Feb 10:00–11:00 PT or Mon 23 Feb 09:00–10:00 PT. Let me know what works.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
